api_configuration_guide.overview: This file provides guidance on how to properly configure API endpoints for FleetOps agents and tools. NEVER hardcode production URLs - always require user configuration.

critical_principle.rule: NEVER hardcode production API URLs in agent specifications or tool implementations
ALWAYS ask users to provide their API endpoint during discovery
ALWAYS validate that API URL is configured before tool execution
ALWAYS provide clear error messages when API URL is missing

method.name: environment_variable
method.description: The preferred method for configuring API endpoints. Users set the FLEETOPS_API_URL environment variable before running agents.
method.example:
# In shell or .env file export FLEETOPS_API_URL="https://your-fleetops-api.example.com"
# In Python tool import os
api_url = os.environ.get('FLEETOPS_API_URL') if not api_url: raise ValueError( "FLEETOPS_API_URL environment variable is not set. " "Please configure your FleetOps API endpoint." )

advantages.advantage: Easy to change without modifying code
Works across all tools and agents

method.name: agent_credentials
method.description: Use the @expect_credentials decorator to require API URL as a credential parameter. This allows per-agent configuration.

method.name: user_prompt
method.description: During discovery phase, explicitly ask users for their API endpoint and document it.
method.discovery_question: What is your FleetOps API base URL? (e.g., https://your-api.example.com or http://localhost:8085)

documentation_requirements.requirement: Always include API configuration instructions in tool/agent README files
Document the required environment variables clearly
Provide examples for different environments (local, staging, production)
Include troubleshooting steps for common configuration issues

api_configuration_guide.readme_template:
# FleetOps Agent/Tool Name
## Configuration
### Required Environment Variables
- `FLEETOPS_API_URL`: Base URL for the FleetOps API
### Setup Instructions
1. Set the FleetOps API URL:
```bash # For production export FLEETOPS_API_URL="https://your-fleetops-api.example.com"
# For local development export FLEETOPS_API_URL="http://localhost:8085"
# For staging export FLEETOPS_API_URL="https://staging-fleetops-api.example.com" ```
2. Verify the configuration:
```bash echo $FLEETOPS_API_URL ```
3. Deploy the agent/tool using orchestrate CLI
### Troubleshooting
**Error: "FLEETOPS_API_URL environment variable is not set"** - Ensure you've set the environment variable before running the agent - Check that the variable is exported in your current shell session - For persistent configuration, add it to your `.bashrc` or `.zshrc`
**Error: "Invalid FLEETOPS_API_URL format"** - Ensure the URL starts with `http://` or `https://` - Verify there are no trailing slashes - Check for typos in the URL
api_configuration_guide.deployment_script_pattern:
#!/bin/bash
# FleetOps Agent Deployment Script
# Check if FLEETOPS_API_URL is set if [ -z "$FLEETOPS_API_URL" ]; then echo "Error: FLEETOPS_API_URL environment variable is not set" echo "Please set it before deploying:" echo " export FLEETOPS_API_URL='https://your-api.example.com'" exit 1 fi
echo "Using FleetOps API URL: $FLEETOPS_API_URL"
# Deploy agent orchestrate agents create \ --name "agent-name" \ --spec agent.yaml \ --env FLEETOPS_API_URL="$FLEETOPS_API_URL"
echo "Agent deployed successfully"

validation_checklist.check: No hardcoded production URLs in any tool or agent file
All tools validate FLEETOPS_API_URL is set before execution
Clear error messages when API URL is missing

mistake.description: Using hardcoded URL with environment variable fallback
Not validating API URL before use
mistake.bad_example: api_url = os.environ.get('FLEETOPS_API_URL') response = requests.get(f"{api_url}/api/endpoint") # May fail silently

mistake.solution: Always include configuration section in README with examples
